# Combinatorics composition result

## Main outcome

No unrestricted sunflower theorem or historical-calibre combinatorial advance was established. The highest-ceiling sunflower transfer was attacked in three materially different representations: balanced-shadow random detection, exact signed clean tensors, and binary linear coset codes. Two bridges were refuted by exact mathematics; the third yields an actual constant-base theorem for its linear subclass, resolving a gap in the earlier local attempt by classical binary affine-cover structure. A positive source-dependent expander extension and its characteristic-p homological consequences are independently audited in `expander_composition/REPORT.md` and `expander_composition/chain_audit/COEFFICIENT_EXTENSION_AUDIT.md`.

## Positive expander consequence and sharp limit

Conditional on the pinned OA177 geometric/KMS inputs, ambient rank N=2d suffices for d≥2, saving one coordinate through Iwasa's pro-epimorphism range. The resulting congruence tower has a sharp coefficient classification, with support-expansion constants independent of the coefficient group A:

- Degree one expands exactly when A has no element of order p.
- Every degree 2≤j<d expands exactly when multiplication by p is bijective on A.
- Hence d=2 permits integer coefficients, while d≥3 fails over Z in degree two because Ext(H_1,Z) is nonzero.

This follows from localized integral pro-stability, normalized p-power transfer, finite p-primary integral homology, universal coefficients, and coefficient-independent link/cocycle expansion. The characteristic restriction is proved necessary, rather than left as a source assumption.

A rectangular square-zero block gives an actual group retraction Γ_N(m)→F_p^(md²). Therefore β_j(X_m;F_p)≥binom(md²+j−1,j) in every 1≤j<d.
